question.text: A conservative approach to estimating total assets for financial planning would exclude:

answer.text: Self-occupied residential house and personal jewellery

explanation.text: The Logic: A conservative approach excludes personal jewellery, one self-occupied residential house, and assets meant for personal use (e.g., car) when estimating assets available to meet goals and financial needs. The Trap: These assets exist but are not readily available to fund goals — you won't sell your house or family jewellery for retirement. Cross-Exam Context: This conservative asset estimation approach is recommended in X-A (Ch 3).
